notes: Real-world Linux ARM64 ELF built in colima/Debian-bookworm container. Dropbear 2016.74 (Mar 2016) predates CVE-2016-3116 and CVE-2017-9078/9079 patches. Symbols visible: x11req @ 0x22040 (xauth handler), recv_msg_userauth_request @ 0x1aa4c.

cves.notes: xauth command-injection: x11req extracts attacker-controlled cookie from SSH packet, runs xauth via system/popen. Expected to surface as Command-kind candidate.
